load_lfb: load an LFB from a pickle file for training or validation
write_lfb: write an LFB dictionary to a pickle file for later loading
construct_lfb: construct an LFB from features and metadata for ava, charades, or epic datasets
get_lfb: get an LFB by inferring from a model or loading from a cached pickle file
construct_frame_level_lfb: construct a frame-level LFB from features and metadata for charades or epic datasets
